title: The Ferry Dock Hand-Offs
story: Between five o'clock and twenty past six on Festival Eve, the ferry dock bustled with errands, and Pilot the beagle greeted everyone in his orange life vest. Five people were each handed something there, from a festival lantern to the spare lighthouse key, and each went on somewhere different. Teddy says he passed the key along on his way to the green. Ada would like the grid's word for it. Who got what, when, and where did each go next?

question.text: Who received the spare key at the ferry dock?

texts: The person headed to the library is either Rosa or Pearl.
The person headed to the inn was handed something earlier than the person headed to the church.
The person headed to the bakery was handed something 20 minutes after the person headed to the inn.
Of the person with the mail sack and the person whose hand-off came at 5:40 p.m., one is Hattie and the other is Kenji.
Of the person with the spare key and the person whose hand-off came at 6:00 p.m., one is Jonah and the other is Rosa.
The person with the lantern is neither Pearl nor Rosa.
Kenji was handed something earlier than the person headed to the inn.
The person whose hand-off came at 6:20 p.m. is either Jonah or Kenji.
The person with the pie tin is either Hattie or Pearl.
Hattie was handed something 20 minutes after the person headed to the store.
